name: zclass_camera_set_viewport
description: zClass_Camera::gwCameraSetViewport stores viewport dimensions and recomputes derived FOV/scale values.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this setter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass_Camera source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: The native camera smoke verifies viewport storage, max-FOV clamp behavior, derived yaw/pitch and viewport scale values, dirty flags, getter round-trip, and null camera error handling.
